relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3-associated autoinflammatory disease (NLRP3-AID) is a rare heterogeneous autoinflammatory disease caused by NLRP3 gene mutations on chromosome 1q44, which results in interleukin (IL)-1β overproduction [1,2].

relationships.subject: canakinumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Two patients (#3 and #6) receiving regular subcutaneous IL-1 inhibitor (canakinumab, q.8w., 150 mg per dose) treatment demonstrated improvements in ODC, and no adverse effects were observed.

key_findings: 50% of Chinese NLRP3-AID patients had optic disc changes, mostly optic disc swelling, associated with hearing loss, CNS involvement and higher inflammatory markers
T348M mutation carriers all had ODS with visual-field defects; IL-1 inhibitor improved ODC in two patients
